rules.rationale: ESOL: long SMILES cut solubility (-11.46); anti-correlated endpoint implies greater octanol partitioning.
Source prior: short SMILES raised solubility (+6.89); small polar molecules partition poorly into octanol.
Ring role had the highest transfer weight (0.758); fused rings add rigid hydrophobic surface area.
Donor-to-heteroatom mapping is the weakest source role (0.159), so keep only a mild polarity penalty.

skills.hypothesis: Sign-reversed ESOL transfer: size and ring content raise lipophilicity, small molecules lower it, with a softened heteroatom penalty. Fails if polarity balance rather than molecular size governs partitioning here.

rules.rationale: Polycyclic aromatic cores are poorly hydrated and dominate octanol affinity in drug-like pools.
Rotatable-bond role transferred strongly (0.758); branched alkyl substituents add nonpolar surface area.
Larger scaffolds carry more hydrophobic surface; retained at reduced weight given low length-role confidence (0.224).
Counter to weakest source mapping: moderate heteroatom counts include lipophilic S, N-aryl and halogen contexts.

skills.hypothesis: Counter-hypothesis that removes and mildly reverses the donor-to-heteroatom penalty and leads with an aromatic fused-core interaction. Fails if polar heteroatom content truly suppresses lipophilicity across this pool.

lesson: Across both development generations the sign-flipped ESOL transfer led (88.7 then 90.08 mean AUC) but the ring/branch counter closed to within 0.4 AUC, so the heteroatom penalty is likely weak, not strongly negative; very narrow rules remain the main variance source.
revision_summary: Retained the deployed source-evidence skill with the heteroatom penalty softened further (-0.25 to -0.18) and slightly reduced semantic mass, reflecting the near-tie with the near-zero-penalty counter. Rebuilt the counter as an aromatic fused-core interaction skill that mildly reverses the weakest source mapping (donor to heteroatom, confidence 0.159) while avoiding low-coverage bins such as halogen_high and hetero_none. Deployed the retained transfer skill; sixteen development seeds are too few for causal claims.
